items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: he said “I have this bass player Miroslav and Alphonse Mouzon and Joe Zawinul on piano,”

ctx.x: And I didn’t say the whole telephone conversation because I thought it would give it away, but he said “I have this bass player Miroslav and Alphonse Mouzon and Joe Zawinul on piano,” and he said “we’d love to have you on guitar.”
